name: Ask
description: Talk to the hub's agent. It answers from what the hub holds, and can change things when asked, after a yes each time. It shows and does for a person only what that person may see and do for themselves on their other screens.

abilities.title: Ask the agent
abilities.description: Ask the hub's agent questions and read its answers. It never shows this person more than their other screens do.

abilities.title: Have the agent do things
abilities.description: Ask the hub's agent to set a value or press a button. It asks this person yes or no each time, showing exactly what would change, and can change only what both it and this person may change.
abilities.caution: The agent can then change, for this person, whatever this person could already change themselves. Nothing is changed without their yes.
